scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid a booked knowledge-test seat becoming a late-change or no-show charge after readiness slips.
Emerging Need: The seat initially fits the review plan, so disturbing it would be premature; later instructor feedback shows the appointment will not be usable while changes are still possible.
Decision Context: Saved appointment terms provide the confirmation reference, permitted candidate-change route, privacy limits, and late-lock fee rule; live calendar, contact, and readiness notices resolve whether and when they matter.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves money and testing flexibility, while waiting until late-lock leaves fee exposure tied to a seat that should not be attended.
